headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: HAM (13)

summary: Oscar Piastri won the Azerbaijan Grand Prix from P2 on the grid, 10.9s ahead of Charles Leclerc, with George Russell completing the podium.
Lando Norris made the biggest climb, from P15 to P4.
Carlos Sainz had a day to forget, dropping from P3 to P18.
The race was neutralised by 1 virtual safety car.
There were 22 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 59 points over Lando Norris.
